title: QuantumIR
description: Shared Quantum Intermediate Representation — contract between Quipper (AGENT_01/BOB), Guppy/NETON (AGENT_02), and Yao.jl/PAX-CODER (AGENT_03). Version 0.1.0.

qubits.description: Total number of qubits in the circuit.

qubit_names.description: Optional symbolic names for qubits, indexed 0..qubits-1. If absent, default names q0..q(N-1) apply.

cbits.description: Total number of classical bits (measurement targets).

ops.description: Ordered sequence of quantum operations (program order).

name.description: Gate name. Standard set: H, X, Y, Z, S, T, Sdg, Tdg, CX, CZ, CCX, SWAP, Rx, Ry, Rz, U1, U2, U3. Custom gates allowed.

params.description: Gate angle parameters in radians (e.g. [pi/4] for T, [theta] for Rz(theta)). Empty list for non-parametric gates.

qubits.description: Qubit indices targeted by this gate, in gate-convention order (control before target for 2Q gates).

cbit.description: Classical bit to write result into.

qubits.description: Qubits over which the barrier is placed. Prevents gate commutation across this boundary.

IRMeta.description: Provenance and capability metadata. MANDATORY: unsupported MUST list every semantic feature that was dropped or approximated during lowering. An empty list means the source language was fully representable — not that the field was omitted.

unsupported.description: Explicit list of source-language semantics NOT representable in this IR instance. NEVER omit silently. If fully representable, set to []. Examples: 'higher-order circuit parameters', 'dynamic lifting (classical feedback)', 'linear-type enforcement'.

IRResources.description: Static resource estimates for the circuit.

gate_count.description: Total number of quantum gate operations (excludes measure, barrier, reset).

depth.description: Critical-path depth: length of the longest chain of gates that must execute sequentially.

t_count.description: Number of T and Tdg gates. The primary resource in fault-tolerant compilation.

width.description: Circuit width = qubit count. Redundant with top-level 'qubits' field; included here for self-contained resource records.

unsupported: higher-order circuit parameters (Quipper BoxedCircuit) — represented as flattened gate sequence
